class_id: child-table provenance filed while the child data row is never written
feature: any caller of the consolidated child-table writer (consolidatedUpsertChildRows, scraper/src/services/data-consolidation-orchestrator.ts) that holds no repository of its own for the table, across every member of ChildConsolidationTable (ipo_details, financial_statements, ipo_valuation, ipo_risk_factors, promoters, anchor_investors, ipo_intermediaries, peer_companies); today the field-plan walk (runWrite, scraper/src/services/field-plan-walk.ts)
symptom: consolidatedUpsertChildRows decides each value and files its field_sources row, but by design did not write the child row; the persisters (filing, anchor) write the row themselves, while the field-plan walk had no row-writing step. Every rank-1 child value the walk supplied was recorded as SUPPLIED with provenance naming a source, while the child column kept its old value or the row did not exist at all: provenance says a value exists that no reader of the table can see.
first_seen: 2026-10-01 (#1419) -- walk-child-row-column-1419.integration.test.ts on ipodhan_test: an ipo_details row holding issue_type FIXED_PRICE plus a planned NSE issue_type BOOK_BUILDING ended with field_sources (ipo_details, issueType, NSE) and the column still FIXED_PRICE; with no ipo_details row, provenance was filed and zero rows existed (red 2/2 before the fix). Population of existing rows, not measured here: field_sources rows whose table_name is one of the eight child tables with no row in that table for the same ipo_id (and, for keyed tables, the same row_key mapped to its key columns).
fix_prs: #1419 (fix/1419-walk-child-row-write): packages/shared/src/repositories/child-row-field-writer.ts is the one row writer for all eight tables (exhaustive Record keyed by table; a compile-time check pins its table set to ChildConsolidationTable); consolidatedUpsertChildRows(..., { writeRow: true }) probes the row BEFORE filing provenance (unknown column, malformed key, not creatable, admin-held => refused with no provenance) and lands the decided values on the keyed row AFTER, re-reading holds under the ipos row lock; the walk always passes writeRow and fails closed (not SUPPLIED) when the result carries no rowWrite or rowWrite.written is false
